artifacts.summary: Re-verified the three in-scope check scripts are green with measured runtimes, recommends --no-build for check-module-invariants.sh on the task's own stated runtime budget, and lays out the four-part wiring-pattern convention (step naming, skip-neutral, cache-warm placement, runtime budget) plus exact step order and commands.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo, check-module-invariants.sh's full (build-dependent) invocation costs ~2 minutes even when the Lake cache and all lean_exe roots are already warm -- the extra cost is dominated by C16's env_linter re-scan across all 14 lakefile roots and the C2 axiom-baseline check, not by re-building anything already built. The --no-build flag runs the structural-only subset in ~20s. When wiring this or a similar phase-gate script into CI, measure both forms with the roots pre-built before assuming --no-build's savings come from skipping a redundant build.

check-copyright-headers.sh's bare invocation (no flags) always exits 0 by design -- it is a report-only mode. The gating form requires --strict plus --exclude '*/Boneyard/*' (or the current archive glob) to avoid counting the deliberately unheadered archive as failures. Any CI wiring or task description referencing this script must use the --strict --exclude form, never the bare form.
